nativeMetricsChangedAfterFreeze.explanation: After all28pairs finished, only this acceptance flag changed fromfalse totrue. Rows, raw source/canonical files, native hashes and runtime inputs stayed identical.

implementation.dimensions: The Gantt renderer shares fixed-font dimensions with planner/dendrogram. Exactly five recorded pairs: default500x243,20:5->200x118,35:9->350x218,15:3->150x68,60:20->600x493. General formulas for chart/table/row/time/scroll geometry remain unproven; axes data are explicit and bounded.
implementation.layout: The recorded native table width, value columns, row heights, timeline periods and scrollbar thumb depend on width and UI language. Header y23,16px line advance, row baselines39+rowHeight*i. Legends are capped at native width and elide with U+2026. The final blue example stops strictly before its right day boundary.
implementation.text: Shared regular13px FreeType LCD. Table/timeline text77, legend51. Hinted following-pair advances for text, unkerned single advances for numeric headings. Partially visible lines use existing ink metrics and logical bounds; the first Russian33px wrapped value fragment has measured advance clipping. The internal LCD JS result now exposes inkLeft/inkRight; no WASM ABI or binary change.
implementation.intervals: Procedural rounded intervals use68 measured scalar coverage values. The color-point layer has a distinct lower-right coverage phase and paints its blue base before orange. Coverage ambiguities on white were constrained by the overlapping blue/orange colors. This is small geometric paint, not a bitmap or per-screenshot pixel correction. Unmeasured combinations remain open.
implementation.scrollbar: The PDF and Gantt share existing native scrollbar cap/arrow paint through scrollbar-paint.mjs; PDF pixel regression passed. Recorded Gantt thumb is8px except default Russian128px; the general thumb rule is not claimed.
implementation.sourceSemantics: Native export removes Font/BackColor/BorderColor/HorizontalLines/VerticalLines. Left/Right/None TableLocation remains canonical XML, but all recorded variants have exactly the default complete RGB surface. ReadOnly/Enabled change only the outer160->232 border. No BSL or runtime documents execute; typed applicability/computed-inspector work remains open.
implementation.capture: Every accepted surface checks the exact full160x23 native form header RGB/name, waits at least2sec and requires two consecutive equal full-control captures. Preliminary stale-MDI captures are preserved/excluded. The600x493 field is stitched only from visible native viewports, with zero-difference overlap and complete bottom border. openedAtUtc in raw provenance denotes the start of the guarded open transaction.
implementation.lifecycle: Solid repaints the same control DOM on dirty dimensions, inactive states, ignored properties and TableLocation. Selected identity survives. The installed test opens a real floating about:blank VS Code window, updates tall/small fields and reattaches. Sources are not written.
implementation.scopeGate: Native paint requires Linux, DPR1, zoom100, en-US and supported ru/en sample labels with the five recorded metric pairs; unsupported display conditions retain browser fallback and the existing localized notice. Other properties/styles/dimensions/combinations, complete applicability and full forms are not accepted.
